description: Main window: read the bundled/app-data corpus; native dialogs for the future import flow. fs:allow-rename is what the library stores need (src/lib/imports.ts, annotations.ts): every file is written to a .tmp beside it and renamed into place, so a crash mid-write cannot leave a truncated map or annotation file. The appdata write set already carries rename; the explicit grant is here so the app cannot lose it to a plugin default change while the suite stays green.
